到家的时候，时间还早。

赵素梅在灶台边忙活，听见动静，探出头来：“回来了？吃饭了没？”

“在县城吃过了。”

林国强把自行车推进院子，支好。

赵素梅看见那辆崭新的自行车，眼睛瞪大了：“这……这是啥？”

“自行车，永久牌的。”林国强拍了拍车座，“以后出门方便了。”

“你买自行车了？”

赵素梅围着自行车转了两圈，不敢相信，“这得多少钱？”

“一百八。”

“一百八？！”赵素梅的声音都变了，“你……你咋花这么多钱？咱们才挣了多少钱……”

“素梅，”林国强握住她的手，“以前出门全靠两条腿，去趟县城走两个多小时，去镇上也得四十分钟。

现在有了车，方便多了。

我去县城进货、买东西，都快一倍。

这钱花得值。”

赵素梅看着那辆崭新的自行车，车架上的黑漆锃亮，车铃在夕阳下反着光。

她伸手摸了摸车座，又缩回去了，像是怕弄脏了似的。

“可是……一百八十块，也太贵了……”

“不贵。”林国强把布包从车把上取下来，“有了它，咱们能挣更多的钱，你信我不？”

赵素梅看着他，看了好一会儿，终于点了点头：“信。”

林国强笑了，拎着布包进了屋。

“你手里拿的啥？”赵素梅跟在后面问。

“给你们买的东西。”

林国强把布包放在炕上，一样一样地往外拿。

“这是给你的。”他把两盒雪花膏和一包东西递过去。

赵素梅接过来，打开一看，愣住了。

“雪花膏？”她拧开盖子闻了闻，茉莉花的香味让她眯起了眼睛，“这……这得多少钱？”

“两块五一盒。”

“两块五一盒？！”赵素梅心疼得直抽抽，“你买这个干啥？我又不……”

“你用。”林国强打断了她，“你手都裂了，擦擦好得快。”

赵素梅低头看了看自己的手。

指节粗大，皮肤粗糙，手背上裂了好几道口子，有的地方还渗着血。

她以前从来不在意这些，在地里刨食的人，谁的手不是这样？

When I got home, it was still early.

Zhao Sumei was busy at the stove. When she heard the noise, she stuck her head out: "You're back? Have you eaten?"

"I ate it in the county seat."

Lin Guoqiang pushed the bicycle into the yard and set it up.

Zhao Sumei's eyes widened when she saw the brand new bicycle: "What... what is this?"

"Bicycle, permanent brand." Lin Guoqiang patted the seat, "It will be more convenient to go out in the future."

"Did you buy a bicycle?"

Zhao Sumei circled the bicycle twice and couldn't believe it, "How much does this cost?"

"One hundred and eighty."

"One hundred and eighty?!" Zhao Sumei's voice changed, "You... why did you spend so much money? How much money did we earn..."

"Su Mei," Lin Guoqiang held her hand, "I used to rely on two legs to go out. It took more than two hours to walk to the county seat and forty minutes to the town.

Now that we have a car, it is much more convenient.

When I go to the county town to buy goods, it’s twice as fast.

It's money well spent."

Zhao Sumei looked at the brand new bicycle. The black paint on the frame was shiny and the bell reflected the light in the setting sun.

She reached out and touched the car seat, then retracted it, as if she was afraid of getting it dirty.

"But... one hundred and eighty yuan is too expensive..."

"It's not expensive." Lin Guoqiang took the cloth bag off the handlebar, "With it, we can make more money, do you believe me?"

Zhao Sumei looked at him for a long time, and finally nodded: "Letter."

Lin Guoqiang smiled and entered the house carrying the cloth bag.

"What are you holding in your hand?" Zhao Sumei asked following behind.

"Things I bought for you."

Lin Guoqiang put the cloth bag on the kang and took it out one by one.

"This is for you." He handed over two boxes of cream and a package.

Zhao Sumei took it, opened it and was stunned.

"Alabaster?" She unscrewed the cap and smelled it. The scent of jasmine made her squint her eyes. "How much does this cost?"

"Two dollars and a box."

"Two yuan for a box?!" Zhao Sumei was so distressed, "Why did you buy this? I don't..."

"You can use it." Lin Guoqiang interrupted her, "Your hands are cracked. Just wipe them and it will heal quickly."

Zhao Sumei looked down at her hands.

The knuckles were thick, the skin was rough, there were several cuts on the back of the hand, and there was blood in some places.

She had never cared about this before. Whose hands didn't look like this when digging for food in the ground?
